text: APPROVE: the extracted `IsFirstPartySource` carries the same extension, ambient-declaration, minified/bundle and `IsSkipped` checks, and `&& --count == 0` short-circuits so `count` still decrements only for qualifying files. That leaves behaviour unchanged, and `AtLeast` loses three nested `if`s with their boolean operators and one lambda, which should bring it well under 15. The new private static helper introduces no obvious build or warning problems. I judged this from reading the diff and did not build the project or run the analyzer.
